tagline: Global leader in commercial aircraft, defense, space and security solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The BCA segment represents approximately 46% of total revenue and is the primary driver of financial growth and volatility, with significant leverage tied to aircraft deliveries and the post-crisis recovery of the air travel market.
company_description: The Boeing Company, together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, sells, services, and supports commercial jetliners, military aircraft, satellites, missile defense, human space flight and launch systems, and services worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Commercial Airplanes; Defense, Space & Security; and Global Services. The Commercial Airplanes segment develops, produces, and markets commercial jet aircraft for passenger and cargo requirements. The Defense, Space & Security segment engages in the research, development, production, and modification of manned and unmanned military aircraft and weapons systems; strategic defense and intelligence systems, which include strategic missile and defense systems, command, control, communications, computers, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance, cyber and information solutions, and intelligence systems; and satellite systems, such as government and commercial satellites, and space exploration. kpis.name: Commercial Airplanes Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of commercial aircraft such as the 737, 777 and 787.
kpis.description: Revenue increased significantly in 2025 due to higher delivery volumes, despite disruptions related to the 737-9 incident in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound following the 2024 quality crisis

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved from -16.1% in 2024 to 4.8% in 2025, driven by production recovery and increased deliveries.
kpis.signal: Return to profitability after three years of losses

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total revenue from all combined segments.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased by 34.5% in 2025, driven by BCA, BDS and BGS, despite production disruptions.

kpis.name: Defense, Space Security Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from military contracts, satellites, defense systems and space programs.
kpis.description: The BDS segment saw revenue growth in 2025 due to reduced negative contract adjustments and improved operational performance.

kpis.name: Global Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from maintenance, training, spare parts and digital services for commercial and military customers.
kpis.description: BGS shows steady growth, driven by demand for commercial and government services.

kpis.name: Core Operating Earnings
kpis.explanation: Operating income excluding exceptional items such as pension-related charges.
kpis.description: Core operating earnings improved from -$11.8B in 2024 to +$3.2B in 2025, reflecting operational stabilization.

kpis.name: Total Backlog
kpis.explanation: Measures the total value of future orders Boeing has yet to deliver, an indicator of commercial health.

kpis.name: 737 Deliveries
kpis.explanation: Number of Boeing 737 aircraft delivered to customers each period, a key indicator of revenue and production.

kpis.name: 787 Deliveries
kpis.explanation: Number of Boeing 787 aircraft delivered to customers, a key indicator of production and revenue.

kpis.name: 737 MAX Production Rate
kpis.explanation: Number of 737 MAX aircraft produced per month. Indicates whether Boeing is recovering production after crises.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Measures the actual cash generated by Boeing's operations each year, showing its true ability to generate cash.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Actual cash Boeing generates after paying expenses, showing its ability to invest or repay debt.

kpis.name: Defense Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Measures the profitability of Boeing's Defense division: the percentage of profit generated per dollar of sales.

kpis.name: 737 Deliveries Impact
kpis.explanation: Impact of 737 aircraft deliveries on BCA revenues.
kpis.description: 737 deliveries resumed in 2025 after a pause in 2024 due to the January incident, leading to a strong increase in BCA revenues.
kpis.signal: Key rebound following the door plug incident

kpis.name: Spirit Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems to vertically integrate fuselage manufacturing.
kpis.description: The December 2025 acquisition enabled Boeing to regain control of 737, 767, 777 and 787 fuselage production, integrating approximately 15,000 employees.
